integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. Exact-rational Bernstein and Taylor certificates give nontrivial numerical brackets. The numerical constants and square-root coefficient were independently recomputed at high precision by the packaged code; this is not an external review.
scientific_limitations: Only the unmodified scalar exact-value, exact-derivative cubic for exponential decay; numerical root digits are reproducible estimates, not interval-certified precision; no assertion about all stiff ODE solvers or general shape-preserving Hermite variants.
title: Sharp positivity threshold and spurious-event bifurcation for cubic Hermite exponential dense output
